title: ModuleTaskSandboxProcessAdapter
responsibility: Build a trusted per-process sandbox-runtime driver that adds a native hardlink deny before the provider is launched.

inputs.name: constructor.config
inputs.description: Optional connect label; null is not an admitted configuration.

inputs.name: command.sdk
inputs.type: absolute string path to pinned sandbox-runtime index.js
inputs.description: Trusted sandbox-runtime module path passed unchanged to the driver.

inputs.name: command.settings
inputs.type: absolute string path to trusted immutable JSON settings
inputs.description: Trusted settings file path passed unchanged to the driver.

inputs.name: command.argv
inputs.description: Provider argument vector serialized without shell interpretation.

inputs.name: validateScratch.path
inputs.description: Trusted scratch root to inspect; the caller supplies an absolute path.

inputs.name: arguments.scope
inputs.description: Validated scope whose scratch and cwd form the isolated provider command.

inputs.name: environment.scope
inputs.description: Validated scope with sealed CLI directory and contract snapshot.

inputs.name: environment.directory
inputs.description: Trusted outer process directory for temporary runtime state.

outputs.name: connect
outputs.description: Configured name or module-task-sandbox-process by default.

outputs.name: command
outputs.description: Node/Bun interpreter argv for a per-process trusted driver. Initializes sandbox-runtime in that process, preserves its filesystem/network policy, inserts (deny file-link) into its pinned macOS profile, then launches provider with inherited stdio. Refuses an unexpected native wrapper format. Closes native proxy state only after child exit; no nested sandbox_apply.

outputs.name: validateScratch
outputs.description: Before native launch, inspect only scratch file metadata with bounded traversal. Reject symbolic links, hardlinked files, special files or excessive entries. No file contents read; safe regular files and directories retained for retries. A preexisting alias into writable scratch must never widen file permissions.

outputs.name: arguments
outputs.description: Builds isolated provider argv with task cwd and generic and Claude temporary directories in scratch.

outputs.name: environment
outputs.description: Selects trusted runtime environment values and sealed contract snapshot; excludes provider API keys.

errors.name: Unknown wrapper shape or sandbox initialization failure
errors.type: safe prelaunch nonzero process result; no unrestricted fallback

errors.name: Unsafe scratch contents
errors.description: Fail closed on any preexisting symbolic/hard link or unsafe special file; no cleanup of caller contents.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Null configuration or method scope throws TypeError when a method reads it.
